ios.desc:
Posture Reminder & AI Coaching for daily neck, back, and shoulder relief. Increase lost height from your poor posture.

Train smarter with Fit AI — your intelligent posture and flexibility coach. NeckFit helps correct posture, improve mobility, and strengthen your upper body with short, guided workouts.

Featuring an AI-powered Posture Reminder, you’ll receive gentle nudges throughout the day to realign and reset your posture.

Key Features:
AI Posture Scan: Assess your posture with cutting-edge AI technology. Receive instant feedback, identify problem areas, and get personalized recommendations to fix and improve posture.

Personalized Exercise Plans: Tailored routines to target forward head posture and strengthen neck muscles, ensuring sustainable results.

Posture Analysis & Feedback: Analyze your posture and muscle stiffness to provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.

Progress Tracking & Notifications: Monitor your journey with visual progress reports and stay motivated with personalized insights and reminders.

90-Day Guided Program: Improve flexibility, mobility, and posture with daily guided stretching exercises. (Available with a subscription or after the free trial.)

Interactive Self-Therapy Sessions: Enjoy easy and effective exercises tailored to your daily routine, promoting a pain-free neck and improved posture. (Available with a subscription or after the free trial.)

Whether you're looking to relieve neck pain, improve posture, or incorporate daily stretching exercises, AI-Posture Correction: NeckFit provides all the tools you need to transform your health and confidence. Start your journey to better posture and pain-free living with NeckFit today!

Subscription Information:
Free Trial: Get started with a free trial. After the trial period, a subscription is required to continue accessing premium features.
Subscription Options: Choose from monthly, three-monthly, or yearly subscription plans to unlock all premium content.


Important Notes:
Disclaimer: The AI Posture Scan is not a medical diagnostic tool. While it provides insights to guide improvements, it may not always deliver perfect results. Please use the app appropriately and consult a medical professional for any health concerns.
Please seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.
